text:
jess_partnerships: Heads-up — AcmeCloud wants a joint launch across Azure Marketplace + a 45-min benchmark webinar + a two-part blog series (teaser + deep dive). Scope: launch post, benchmark narrative, webinar ops, lead routing, messaging A/B. Need owners and high-level timeline.

maria_growth: Love it. I can draft the teaser post + blog outline. Will need benchmark data from Eng and a few customer quotes.

leo_pm: I can pull perf numbers and a short matrix comparing latency/cost vs base model for the blog. Need env details and workloads.

sam_marketing: For webinar ops — we should do a split funnel: teaser -> registration -> live -> gated deep-dive PDF. Who owns the registration page and UTM scheme? Also recommended panel: Acme TPM, our infra PM, and a customer.

ash_sales: Sales ask — route registrants that are >50 seats or enterprise to AE queue "Partners-ACME". Small dev trials go to self-serve nurture. Can we add a 1-click trial link with prefilled UTM?

olga_ops: I'll own lead routing. Proposed rule (simple):
```
if lead.company_size >= 50 -> queue Partners-ACME
else -> queue MQL-Nurture
UTM params: utm_source=acme_partner&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=acme_launch_v1
```
I'll also add a webhook to Salesforce mapping.

maria_growth: For messaging A/B: version A = product-first (performance + cost), version B = outcomes-first (time-to-value + integration ease). We can run both in a small paid social test and pick before the webinar. Need copy + 2 hero images.

leo_pm: Bench plan: run 3 representative prompts (short chat, long chat, embedding search) on Acme infra sim and our Hosted + Dedicated configs. I'll drop raw numbers by EOD Friday.

sam_marketing: Timeline proposal:
- Draft teaser post + CTAs: 5 business days
- Bench data + blog draft: 7 business days after numbers in
- Webinar dry-run + landing page: 10 business days
- Lead routing + SF mapping: 3 business days
Can we commit to dates?

jess_partnerships: Suggested owners: Maria = content (teaser + blog), Leo = bench, Sam = webinar + landing, Olga = routing, Ash = sales intake + customer invite. I'll sync with Acme PM on panel confirmations today. Can everyone add blockers by EOD? :thumbsup:

maria_growth: Adding blocker — need a 30-60s customer quote or quick case snippet. If Acme can share one, I can lift it into the teaser.

ash_sales: I can ask two customers for short quotes. Will update by tomorrow.

olga_ops: Blocking question — do we prefer API-based trial provisioning or a coupon code? API is nicer but needs a dev task.

leo_pm: API trial will require a small infra ticket. If timeline tight, fallback to coupon and automation for provisioning.

sam_marketing: I'll start landing page w/ coupon option and leave an API flag for ops to swap when ready.

jess_partnerships: Great, thanks. I'll send a one-pager to Acme + a kickoff invite. Follow-ups: Maria — start teaser draft; Leo — bench numbers; Sam — seed landing; Olga — begin SF mapping. We'll reconvene Wed for a status check. :sparkles:
